message.content: {"thought": "The timeline confirms the critical path ends at ~29.1B latency on core5, with average core utilization of 68.5%. The FFN1 tilings are purely compute-bound with 99.99% compute time. The bottleneck is clear: 4096 compute units per WS chiplet are insufficient for the FFN1 GEMMs. The recommended focus includes compute_units, num_chiplets, chiplet_type, tensor_parall. Since the FFN1 tilings are perfectly compute-bound and each maps to one of 16 chiplets via tensor_parall=16, increasing compute_units per chiplet from 4096 to 16384 would directly reduce FFN1 latency by ~4x. However, this would increase monetary cost. I should check the monetary cost breakdown and also examine layer loads to confirm the FFN1 dominance before proposing a change.", "action": "tool", "tool": {"name": "summarize_monetary_cost", "arguments": {"top_components": 12}}}
